# odoo-work-cli llm

## NAME

odoo-work-cli-llm - Print a usage guide for LLM agents (--skill)

## SYNOPSIS

```text
odoo-work-cli llm [--skill]
```

## DESCRIPTION

With --skill, print a Markdown guide for coding agents on standard
output: how to call the CLI, the JSON contract, every error kind with what
to do about it, and the usual pitfalls. It starts with skill front matter
(name, description), so it can be saved as a Claude Code skill as is.

The error kinds and the JSON fields in the guide are generated from the
same sources as the CLI, so the guide always matches the installed
version. Without --skill the command fails with a validation error.

## OPTIONS

`--skill`
:   Print the agent guide (Markdown) on stdout.

    *flag; optional*

## GLOBAL OPTIONS

`--backend` *BACKEND*
:   BACKEND: odoo or fake (offline, made-up data; env ODOO_WORK_CLI_BACKEND).

    *string; optional; default: odoo; env: ODOO_WORK_CLI_BACKEND*

`--config` *FILE*
:   Read only the config FILE (skip discovery).

    *string; optional*

`-h`, `--help`
:   Print the help of the command and exit.

## OUTPUT

The guide, as Markdown.

## EXIT STATUS

0 on success, 1 on any error, including usage errors. The error is printed as "Error: TEXT" on standard error.

Error kinds this command can fail with:

`validation`
:   Invalid input: unknown flag, bad argument, malformed date, time or hours, a time in the future, an unknown project.

`internal`
:   Anything else: an unexpected Odoo response or a bug.

## EXAMPLES

Install the guide as a Claude Code skill:

```console
$ mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills/odoo-work-cli
$ odoo-work-cli llm --skill > ~/.claude/skills/odoo-work-cli/SKILL.md
```
